item.title: Here's how much snow parts of Minnesota got on Saturday, Feb. 28
item.description: Impressive snow totals were reported in parts of Minnesota after a narrow band of heavy snowfall worked its way across the state. item.title: Minneapolis shooting injures 2 women
item.description: Minneapolis police are investigating after gunfire left two women injured overnight. Shooting in Minneapolis injures 2 Minneapolis police say they responded to a reported shooting at a parking lot in the 300 block of Cedar Avenue South just before 1:20 a.m. on Sunday, March 1. Officers then found an 18-year-old woman with a non-life-threatening gunshot wound. She was then taken to the hospital.
